offerings.name: Reader for web search and SERP（https://s.jina.ai）
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on token usage. Toy Experiment: 10 Million Tokens，Free；Prototype Development: 1 Billion Tokens，$50；Production Deployment: 11 Billion Tokens，$500。
offerings.output_type: 包含前五条结果及其 URL 和内容的 LLM-friendly text block
offerings.note: 每次搜索固定消耗至少 10,000 tokens；无 API key 受限，免费 API key 为 100 RPM，付费 API key 为 1,000 RPM。
